description: Source code defining the Draft struct and associated methods for handling draft messages in Mattermost, including validation, property management, and pre-save processing.

classes.name: Draft
classes.description: Represents a draft message with metadata, validation, and utility methods.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the draft message size and overall integrity.

methods.name: BaseIsValid
methods.description: Performs basic validation checks on the draft's fields.

methods.name: SetProps
methods.description: Sets the properties of the draft with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: GetProps
methods.description: Retrieves the properties of the draft with thread-safe locking.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the draft for saving by setting timestamps and resetting delete flag.

methods.name: PreCommit
methods.description: Finalizes the draft's state before commit, including removing duplicate file IDs.
